build_cross_attention_module: build a CrossAttention module with configurable heads, head_dim, and RMSNorm for encoder-decoder attention
run_cross_attention_forward: run the CrossAttention forward pass with query tensor, key-value tensor, and optional BlockMask
init_cross_attention_weights: initialize CrossAttention weights using truncated normal distribution with configurable base_std and factor
build_global_transformer: build a GlobalTransformer with token embedding projection and causal mask support for latent sequences
run_global_transformer_forward: run the GlobalTransformer forward pass with tokens, embeddings, causal mask, and optional cache
